description: This source file contains functions for generating and configuring CU-CP (Central Unit - Control Plane) configurations, including QoS, security, report configurations, and network connection settings, as well as worker manager setup for a 3GPP-based radio system implementation.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_qos_config
methods.description: Generates QoS configuration map for CU-CP based on unit configuration.

methods.name: generate_preferred_integrity_algorithms_list
methods.description: Creates a list of preferred integrity algorithms from security config.

methods.name: generate_preferred_ciphering_algorithms_list
methods.description: Creates a list of preferred ciphering algorithms from security config.

methods.name: generate_rrc_ssb_mtc
methods.description: Generates RRC SSB measurement timing configuration.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_periodical_report_config
methods.description: Builds periodical report configuration for CU-CP.

methods.name: build_meas_trigger_threshold
methods.description: Builds measurement trigger quantity for absolute thresholds.

methods.name: build_meas_trigger_offset
methods.description: Builds measurement trigger quantity for relative offsets.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_trigger_report_config
methods.description: Builds trigger report configuration for CU-CP based on event type.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_config
methods.description: Generates full CU-CP configuration from unit config.

methods.name: generate_n2_client_config
methods.description: Creates network connection client configuration, optionally for no-core mode.

methods.name: fill_cu_cp_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates worker manager configuration with CU-CP executor and PCAP settings.
